correctness.rationale: The Fourier constants were checked directly from the strip indicator and the double-Hilbert quadrant multiplier. Abel-regularized differentiation gives an exact formula for J''; the Frullani identity then yields a convergent power series whose twice-integrated coefficients reproduce the stated defect expansion and leading constant 2/pi. Positive-dilation covariance gives the slope/cutoff extension.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The inspected arXiv:2609.15155v1 proves only an upper bound of order sqrt(epsilon |log epsilon|) for the continuous strip and gives an exact no-log dyadic defect. Exact and synonymous searches found no prior matching lower asymptotic, leading constant, or convergent expansion, and no SCOPE overlap was found. The source preprint is very recent, so unindexed contemporaneous observations remain the principal residual risk.

value.rationale: The calculation resolves a quantitative feature explicitly highlighted by the source paper: the continuous logarithm is intrinsic, not a proof artifact. It gives the sharp constant, all small-width correction terms through a convergent series, and an asymptotically growing continuous/dyadic defect separation at matched width.
